Scottie Barnes led the Raptors with 28 points (12-22 FG, 1-4 3PT), 10 rebounds and 8 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 50.5 to 62.5.
Biggest swing: Jakob Poeltl shooting foul (Q4 11:22), +10 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Hunter, Allen, Merrill, Mobley, -1 in 12:23.
Bench points: CLE 41, TOR 33. Points in the paint: 54–60. Second-chance points: 20–16.
